verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stagehand persisting data: server-side caching of act/observe/extract results, a user-data directory that stays in place after shutdown, and Browserbase contexts. It also offers regional placement for jurisdiction. None of these documents a control over how long data is kept or a way to delete it. Data residency and browser-state persistence are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
